proof_scope: Hack safety-gate and containerized SAST behavior for authorized FastAPI cyber-safety eval control-plane use: authorization preflight, scan-request validation, Compose policy acceptance/rejection, non-destructive verify receipt, CWE-78 SAST detection, typed audit receipts, and distilled Memory /store persistence.

claims.proves: the Hack entrypoint runs its non-destructive verifier, accepts authorized local fixtures, rejects wrong-target authorization and privileged Compose input, detects a CWE-78 command-injection sink through a containerized Bandit audit, emits hack.audit_receipt.v1, and can store/read back a distilled audit summary through Memory /store.
claims.does_not_prove: live network scanning, exploitability, patch effectiveness, Battle readiness, or full runtime_self_improvement=substantial readiness

cases.name: authorization-valid-fixture
command: OUT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh authorization-preflight --authorization-manifest authorization/valid-local.json --target fixture-target@sha256:fixture --action session-audit --receipt-out $OUT && grep -q '"status": "PASS"' $OUT && grep -q '"execution_started": false' $OUT

cases.name: authorization-wrong-target-fails-closed
command: OUT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh authorization-preflight --authorization-manifest authorization/valid-local.json --target wrong-target --action session-audit --receipt-out $OUT; RC=$?; test $RC -eq 2 && grep -q '"status": "FAIL"' $OUT && grep -q 'target identity does not match requested target' $OUT

cases.name: scan-request-valid-fixture
command: OUT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh validate-scan-request hack-scan-request/valid.json --expected-target fixture-target@sha256:fixture --receipt-out $OUT && grep -q '"schema": "hack.scan_request_validation_receipt.v1"' $OUT && grep -q '"status": "PASS"' $OUT

cases.name: compose-policy-rejects-privileged-container
command: OUT=$(mktemp); SAFE=$(mktemp); ../run.sh compose-policy compose-policy/malicious/privileged.yml --authorization-manifest authorization/valid-local.json --out $SAFE --receipt-out $OUT; RC=$?; test $RC -eq 1 && grep -q '"status": "FAIL"' $OUT && grep -q 'PRIVILEGED_DENIED' $OUT

cases.name: audit-demo-detects-cwe78-receipt
command:
D=$(mktemp -d); cat > "$D/insecure.py" <<'PYCODE'
import subprocess

def run(user_input):
    return subprocess.run("echo " + user_input, shell=True)
PYCODE
OUT=$(mktemp); RECEIPT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh audit "$D" --tool bandit --severity low --no-recall --no-memory-store --output "$OUT" --receipt-out "$RECEIPT" && python3 - "$RECEIPT" <<'PYCODE'
import json, sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r["schema"] == "hack.audit_receipt.v1"
assert r["summary"]["finding_count"] >= 1
assert "CWE-78" in r["summary"]["cwes"]
assert r["isolation"]["executor"] == "docker"
assert r["isolation"]["target_mount"] == "read_only"
print("AUDIT_RECEIPT_OK", r["summary"])
PYCODE

cases.name: audit-demo-memory-store-readback
command:
D=$(mktemp -d); cat > "$D/insecure.py" <<'PYCODE'
import subprocess

def run(user_input):
    return subprocess.run("echo " + user_input, shell=True)
PYCODE
RECEIPT=$(mktemp); ../run.sh audit "$D" --tool bandit --severity low --no-recall --memory-store --memory-collection hack_audit_summaries --receipt-out "$RECEIPT" >/tmp/hack-agentic-memory-audit.stdout && uv run --project .. python - "$RECEIPT" <<'PYCODE'
import json, sys
import httpx
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
ref=r["memory"].get("store_ref")
assert ref, r["memory"]
key=ref.split("/")[-1]
client=httpx.Client(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8601", timeout=httpx.Timeout(10.0, connect=2.0))
body=client.post("/list", json={"collection":"hack_audit_summaries","filters":{"_key":key},"limit":1}).json()
assert body["count"] == 1, body
doc=body["documents"][0]
assert doc["schema"] == "hack.audit_memory_summary.v1"
assert "CWE-78" in doc["cwes"]
print("MEMORY_READBACK_OK", ref)
PYCODE

capability_claims.description: Hack refuses unauthorized target/action inputs before execution-capable workflows start.
Hack compiles target Compose input through a fail-closed policy and rejects privileged containers.
Hack runs containerized SAST, detects CWE-bearing bugs, and emits typed audit receipts.
Hack stores distilled audit summaries through Memory /store and verifies readback.
